title: REPEATS EVERY cycle-length buttons render ~41px tall, under the 44px tap target
detail: The 7/8/14/28-day preset buttons override the shared `.hrs .hc` style (`.hrs .hc{padding:11px;...font-size:14px}`, index.html:323) with an inline `{fontSize:13,padding:'11px 4px'}`. Height ≈ 2×11px padding + 2×1.5px border + ~13×1.2 line-height ≈ 40.6px, below the 44px guideline for a primary choice control at the top of every new-pattern flow.
failure: Picking the rotation length is the first tap a nurse makes when starting a new pattern; a ~41px-tall pill is more likely to be mis-tapped one-handed than the rest of the app's already-borderline `.hc` buttons (which sit at ~41.8px by default but aren't further narrowed).
fix: Drop the inline font/padding override (or raise vertical padding back toward the default ~13px+) so the button reaches 44px tall; if horizontal space for 4 pills plus the custom-length input is the concern, let the row wrap onto two lines instead of shrinking button height.
